class.name: EditorExportPlatformWindowsInterDVD
class.brief_description: Exports a burnable VIDEO_TS / AUDIO_TS folder, ZIP, or ISO.
class.description: Does not copy an engine executable and does not use a [code].inter_dvd[/code] template flavor. Missing ffmpeg is a configuration warning, not a missing engine template. ISO output needs [code]oscdimg[/code] or [code]mkisofs[/code] (Editor Setting [code]export/inter_dvd/iso_tool[/code]). Test the result on a burnt disc or a standalone DVD player, not inside Blazium.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], export writes a dummy title VOB if no MPEG-2 cell is configured. Keep [code]false[/code] for production discs.
When [code]true[/code], export searches [code]PATH[/code] (and [code]FFMPEG_EXE[/code]) for ffmpeg. The discovered path is never written into the project or preset.
Optional ffmpeg override. Leave empty and use [member inter_dvd/auto_find_ffmpeg] so no machine-specific path is stored in the project.
